mapper.select: SELECT TEAM_SN FROM TB_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT TO_CHAR(TEAM_SN) AS code, TEAM_NM AS name FROM TB_TEAM WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND DEPT_CD = 'DP030' ORDER BY TEAM_SN
SELECT CD AS code, CD_NM AS name FROM TB_COM_CD WHERE GROUP_CD = 'SCHSE' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_SEQ

sql.if: AND P.PBANC_SN IN (SELECT M.PBANC_SN FROM TB_PRP_TMMBR M WHERE M.USER_ID = #{memberId})

mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(P.PBANC_SN) AS code, P.PBANC_NM AS name FROM TB_PRP_TMMBR M JOIN TB_BID_PBANC P ON P.PBANC_SN = M.PBANC_SN WHERE M.USER_ID = #{userId} AND P.PBANC_STTS_CD NOT IN ('PS010', 'PS090') ORDER BY P.PBANC_SN DESC
SELECT TO_CHAR(PBANC_SN) AS code, PBANC_NM AS name FROM TB_BID_PBANC WHERE SPRVSN_TEAM_SN = #{teamSn} AND PBANC_STTS_CD IN ('PS030', 'PS040', 'PS050') ORDER BY PBANC_SN DESC

SELECT CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS id, TO_CHAR(P.BID_DDLN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS eventDate, TO_CHAR(P.BID_DDLN_DT, 'HH24:MI') AS timeText, '제출 마감 · ' || P.PBANC_NM AS title, 'SC010' AS kindCd, TM.TEAM_NM AS teamNm, P.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, P.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, TM.TEAM_SN AS teamSn FROM TB_BID_PBANC P JOIN TB_TEAM TM ON TM.TEAM_SN = P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN WHERE P.PBANC_STTS_CD NOT IN ('PS010', 'PS090') AND P.BID_DDLN_DT >= TO_DATE(#{from}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND P.BID_DDLN_DT < TO_DATE(#{to}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
mapper.sql: S.SCHDL_SN AS id, TO_CHAR(S.SCHDL_BGNG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS eventDate, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(S.SCHDL_BGNG_DT, 'HH24:MI') = '00:00' THEN NULL ELSE TO_CHAR(S.SCHDL_BGNG_DT, 'HH24:MI') END AS timeText, S.SCHDL_TTL AS title, S.SCHDL_SE_CD AS kindCd, TM.TEAM_NM AS teamNm, S.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, P.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, S.TEAM_SN AS teamSn
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_SCHDL S JOIN TB_TEAM TM ON TM.TEAM_SN = S.TEAM_SN LEFT JOIN TB_BID_PBANC P ON P.PBANC_SN = S.PBANC_SN WHERE S.SCHDL_SN = #{schdlSn} AND S.TEAM_SN = #{teamSn} AND S.AUTO_REG_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SCHDL (TEAM_SN, PBANC_SN, SCHDL_SE_CD, SCHDL_TTL, SCHDL_BGNG_DT, AUTO_REG_YN, RGTR_ID) VALUES (#{teamSn}, #{pbancSn}, #{kindCd}, #{title}, TO_DATE(#{dateTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), 'N', #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SCHDL SET PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn}, SCHDL_TTL = #{title}, SCHDL_BGNG_DT = TO_DATE(#{dateTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') WHERE SCHDL_SN = #{schdlSn} AND TEAM_SN = #{teamSn} AND AUTO_REG_YN = 'N'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_SCHDL WHERE SCHDL_SN = #{schdlSn} AND TEAM_SN = #{teamSn} AND AUTO_REG_YN = 'N'
